tensions.name: WS SSAP all-unlock myth vs three-tier ACG reality

side_a.position: Root via luna-send all-role unlocks essentially every TV-private Luna method, so the WS 401 is just a thin veil.
side_a.evidence: luna-service-bus-webos-homebrew-project states luna-send as root has pseudo-role all; piccap elevates via org.webosbrew.hbchannel.service/exec to capture flatbuffer

side_b.position: Stock WS is three-tier — ~30 verbs succeed stock, ~8–12 unlock via requiredPermissions, TV-proprietary private still 401; root only flips third tier and OTA can revert roles.
side_b.evidence: security-guide-webos-open-source-edition defines dev/part/oem TrustLevel and requiredPermissions generative rule; live 10.1.1.209 probe shows 401 over WS but success via root luna-send

tensions.resolution: Side B is load-bearing — the three-tier model explains both why requiredPermissions unlocks a subset without root and why hyperion capture still needs elevate-service; the draft's section 1 table must show stock vs OSE-query vs private rows, not binary stock-vs-root.

tensions.name: ActivityManager keep-alive vs systemd init.d persistence

side_a.position: Foreground+explicit+persist ActivityManager activity with FakeActivityManager stub is sufficient and memoryd-aware.
side_a.evidence: javascript-service-faq-webos-tv-developer 5s No active activities kill; activity-manager-api-reference-guide-webos-tv-developer foreground/persist/explicit semantics

side_b.position: Only webosbrew init.d native companion under /var/lib/webosbrew/startup.sh survives sam/memoryd and OTA as PID 1 companion, Activities do not survive reboot without persist DB.

tensions.resolution: Both needed — hybrid is the synthesis: ActivityManager for JS service liveness within boot, init.d native for boot-persistent flatbuffer and WS server; the draft must budget both in section 4.

tensions.name: Homebrew elevate-service vs direct dev/install — which survives channel churn

side_a.position: Homebrew hbchannel.service/install with SHA256 and spawn as root is de-facto and proven on 10.1.1.209.
side_a.evidence: github-tbsnillerpiccap manual scp + luna dev/install via elevate-service; github-webosbrewwebos-homebrew-channel hbchannel.service/install

side_b.position: Direct luna://com.webos.appInstallService/dev/install over Dropbear 22/ares 9922 is portable if Homebrew is removed or in failsafe.
side_b.evidence: cli-developer-guide-webos-tv-developer ares-install; github-webosbrewdev-manager-desktop devmode manager on port 9922

tensions.resolution: Consented hybrid — probe HB exec first, use HB install when HB proves root, fallback to scp+/tmp/sha256+dev/install; draft section 3 must show version pinning and rollback in HA diagnostics.

tensions.name: WS re-use client_key vs MQTT brokered discovery

side_a.position: Single WS wss://:3001 re-using bscpylgtv StorageSqliteDict client_key plus mDNS TXT is enough for Platinum local_push.
side_a.evidence: bscpylgtvbscpylgtvwebos_clientpy-at-master-chros73bscpylgtv-github 2112-line client with ping_interval and subscriptions; corehomeassistantcomponentswebostv__init__py local_push coordinator

side_b.position: MQTT with HA discovery, birth/will, retain auto-creates entities and handles last-will better than bespoke WS.

tensions.resolution: WS mandatory, MQTT opt-in — broker adds second credential store and split-brain for no sink entity; hybrid with mDNS advertisement and 2s getCapabilities probe balances Platinum inject-websession.

tensions.name: Ambient capture flagship vs AI Picture Pro dropout cost

side_a.position: Ambient capture via hyperion-webos unicapture is the mind-blowing flagship and worth the AI Picture Pro off tradeoff.
side_a.evidence: github-tbsnillerpiccap backends libvt/libhalgal quirks 0x1-0x100; github-webosbrewhyperion-webos blending vtCapture+halgal

side_b.position: AI Picture Pro/Brightness/Genre conflict causes 200-500ms flatbuffer dropouts and Enact Lovelace at 120MB PSS competes with memoryd low 250MB threshold on CX 3GB.

tensions.resolution: Flagship but scoped — capture at 256x144@30 flatbuffer with UI halgal disabled, AI modes off, as explicit contract; dashboard suspended Enact warm via foreground Activity, not continuous.

tensions.name: Gold→Platinum strict-typing vs bscpylgtv sync wrapper

side_a.position: Sister integration can reach Platinum by adding py.typed + .strict-typing wrapper around sync bscpylgtv 0.5.3 without upstream PEP-561.

side_b.position: bscpylgtv is websockets-only with StorageSqliteDict blocking; Platinum inject-websession/dependency-is-async demands async_get_clientsession passthrough and thus migration to aiowebostv.

tensions.resolution: Surgical wrapper wins for roadmap phase 1 — wrap websockets client with HA executor + session passthrough and typed ConfigEntry[Coordinator]; aiowebostv migration is phase 2, not blocking Platinum.
